observations.observation: The Malaysian Malay product page titles the item Pensil warna but repeatedly describes the same colored-pencil product as Pensel, including Pensel larut air and Pensel direka bentuk.
observations.limitations: This is one retailer and a colored-pencil product, not a frequency comparison. It is contrary evidence to any categorical claim that pensil is absent in Malaysian usage, and it does not by itself establish national preference.
